prompt: Based on the attached character, please create an official-style character reference sheet. Include three-view turnarounds (front, side, back), a 6-variant facial expression row (neutral, smiling, annoyed, embarrassed, determined, tearful), exploded detail callouts for signature equipment (a weathered leather satchel, a compass pendant, a patched travel cloak), a labeled color palette with hex-like swatches, and a short worldbuilding blurb in the corner establishing the character is a cartographer in a post-storm archipelago. Clean white background, organized grid layout, soft pencil under-drawing visible, polished painted finish on top, high resolution, professional concept-art production-book style
riskNote: 第三方图文案例仅用于学习拆解；发布或商用前回到原页面确认授权。
publishAngle: 适合沉淀为 Image2 能力边界与复刻提示词样例。
